Independent quotient nontriviality and endpoint arithmetic checks
correctness.rationale: The incidence filtration exhausts all vertex functions and has quotient eigenvalues (-1)^i binom(n-k-i,k-i). The i=2 layer is nonzero: for four distinct points a,b,c,e outside a fixed (k-2)-set U, the alternating evaluation at U+ac, U+be, U+ae, U+bc kills constants and single-point indicators but not the ac indicator. The alternating sign and decreasing magnitudes thus give the nonconstant upper adjacency eigenvalue t stated. t/d<=3/10, N>=56 and d>=10 imply the Rayleigh lower bound is greater than 3d for smallest components of size 5 or more; a size-four set costs at least 4d-12>3d-4. A connected triple attains exactly 3d-4 for a path and 3d-6 for a triangle, with existence governed by whether three disjoint k-sets fit. Deleting any three vertices cannot disconnect the complement: a smaller component would send at most 3 edges per vertex out but its Rayleigh bound is at least 3.5 per vertex. Therefore a suitable triple boundary is admissible. For an optimum, the smallest component must be such a triple, and equality forces no deletions besides its boundary. The unique small component distinguishes cuts, so choosing the path middle and two neighbors, or choosing three ordered disjoint sets and dividing by six, gives exactly the reported counts. The endpoint arithmetic gives (26,2520) at (8,3) and (54,280) at (9,3).
residual_risks: Finite supporting tests were not re-executed and cannot establish the infinite ranges. No statement about 2k+1<=n<3k-1 or about nonminimum cuts is validated.

value.rationale: The sharp edge separation level and full optimizer set are natural invariants of the higher-rank disjointness graph. The switch from acyclic paths to triangles at three-way disjointness is reflected both in cut size and in the census. The uniform small-boundary argument excludes all larger competing components, including cuts initially allowed to have many components or redundant deletions. This extends beyond an isolated count or a rephrasing of ordinary or cyclic connectivity.
residual_risks: The precise additional contribution in the triangle range relative to the inaccessible cyclic literature remains unresolved; no broad application to other graph families or restricted levels is asserted.
